# Palette usage

<!-- TODO(content): fill from the official brand guide. The source of truth for values is assets/org_style.py; this file explains when to use each one. -->

| Name | Use for |
|---|---|
| `PRIMARY` | The main series or the highlighted value |
| `SECONDARY` | Comparison series |
| `ACCENT` | Callouts, a single point of attention |
| `POSITIVE` / `NEGATIVE` | Favorable / unfavorable variation only |
| `NEUTRAL` | Context, reference lines, de-emphasized categories |

Rules:

- Highlight one thing per chart with `PRIMARY` or `ACCENT`; the rest goes `NEUTRAL`.
- Do not use `POSITIVE`/`NEGATIVE` as plain categorical colors.
